name: Backed IB01 Treasury Bond 0-1yr
oneLiner: bIB01 is Backed's NAV-accreting tracker token for the BlackRock iShares 0-1 year U.S. Treasury Bond UCITS ETF, KYC-gated under Swiss DLT Act framework.

obituary.epitaph: Backed retired its first token line
obituary.obituary: Backed announced in March 2026 that it was consolidating onto xStocks and would gradually wind down the bToken line, including bIB01, by the end of 2026. New bIB01 issuance is closed and the issuer still supports redemption for existing holders.

collateral: Tracker certificate fully backed by the BlackRock iShares $ Treasury Bond 0-1yr UCITS ETF (IB01), held in segregated custody and administered by Backed Assets (Jersey) Limited under Swiss DLT Act framework
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting tracker token (not pegged to $1); price reflects the underlying iShares 0-1yr T-bill ETF NAV with continuous yield accrual; new issuance closed; KYC-gated redemption remains supported by Backed during the announced wind-down; secondary liquidity on Uniswap and CoW Protocol

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: bIB01 is a NAV-accreting tracker certificate fully backed by shares of the iShares 0-1 year U.S. Treasury Bond UCITS ETF. It is not a fixed $1 payment claim; within the closed taxonomy, tbill preserves the tokenized short-Treasury fund exposure and its fund-NAV behavior.

notices.title: New issuance closed; redemption supported
notices.message: Backed plans to wind down bTokens by the end of 2026. New bIB01 issuance is closed; existing holders retain the standard redemption process during the wind-down. Backed lists TBLLx as the ETF upgrade destination, with the exchange ratio determined by the issuer.

notices.title: Coverage excludes unsold inventory
notices.message: The Polygon Chainlink LedgerLens feed reports underlying ETF shares. Pharos publishes coverage only when fresh on-chain supply minus two issuer-documented inventory wallets reconciles with Backed's circulating-supply API across all eight documented chains. The API has no observation timestamp of its own; any failed or mismatched read withholds the ratio.
